tool_args.rationale: The five rows already reach the target horizon, but s_grad spans only 0.018. The open-branch probe adds gradient leverage to separate vmax from rho and distinguish a signed square-root branch from linear leakage. Fit over the full fallback bounds after acquisition.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon model with a signed square-root branch now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: With s_grad nearly constant, the pilot constrains the combined base amplitude much better than vmax and rho separately.
Costs more and does not directly target the missing variation in s_grad.
